Book

Single author

Author surname, Initial(s). (Year). Title . Place of publication: Publisher.

Aaker, D. A. 1991. Managing Brand Equity: Capitalizing on the Value of a Brand Name. York, NY: The Free Press.

6 or 7 authors

Author surname, Initial(s)., Author surname, Initial(s)., Author surname, Initial(s)., Author surname, Initial(s)., Author surname, Initial(s). & Author surname, Initial(s). (Year). Title . Place of publication: Publisher.
Heng, C., Badner, V., Clemens, D., Mercer, L., Mercer, D. & Kumar, V. (2007). The relationship of cigarette smoking to postoperative complications from dental extractions among female inmates. New York: John Wiley and Son Inc.

Chapter in a book

Author surname, Initial(s). (Year). Title of Chapter. In Author surname, Initial(s). Author surname, Initial(s). & Author surname, Initial(s)(Eds.), Title of the Book (pp. page number). Place of publication: Publisher.
Lawrence, J. A., & Dodds, A. E. (2003). Goal-directed activities and life-span development. In J. Valsiner & K. Connolly (Eds.), Handbook of developmental psychology. (pp. 517-533). London, England: Sage Publications.

Journal

E-journal article

With DOI

Author surname, Initial(s). & Author surname, Initial(s). (Year). Title of journal. Journal name, volume(issue), pagr number. Doi:(Available)
Lillis, T., & Turner, J. (2001). Student writing in higher education: Contemporary confusion, traditional concerns. Teaching in Higher Education, 6, 57-68. doi: 10.1080/13562510020029608

Author surname, Initial(s). & Author surname, Initial(s). (Year). Title of journal. Journal name, volume(issue), pagr number. Retrieved from http://www.tandfonline.com

Author surname, Initial(s). & Author surname, Initial(s). (Year). Title of the article. News paper. Retrieved from URL
